name: [#ff5959]Swordium []Mini Core
description:
A core made out of [#ff5959]swordium[], made for mobile bases, can be upgraded to any core of your choice that's larger than 2x2, cheaper than it's 3x3 counterpart, but also weaker.
[red]disclaimer: avoid deconstructing this core if it's the only core in the sector!
details: due to the small size of this core, an accelerator for the core is not viable, cannot be deconstructed once upgraded.
